confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general city and regional knowledge. Food anchors are more stable than lodging and bar prices; Oaxaca has strong visitor demand, and the November 2026 stay window is future-dated, so room rates in particular may vary substantially.
comparable_city_reasoning: Broadly based on tourist-oriented historic centers in southern and central Mexico, with Oaxaca's unusually strong culinary and international tourism demand supporting somewhat higher visitor-facing prices.
